test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the greatest possible length (in meters) that can be used to exactly measure the lengths 6 m, 5 m 25 cm, and 12 m 50 cm.
solution:
Concept Used:

Find HCF of all the length.

Calculation:

Convert all length into cm (1 m = 100 cm) and factorise all

6 m = 600 cm = 25 × 24

5 m 25 cm = 525 cm = 25 × 21

12 m 50 cm = 1250 cm = 25 × 50

Now find out HCF of all the length we get 25.

∴ The greatest possible length that can be used to exactly measure the lengths is 25 cm.
